issue.title: Profile and restore healthy sase agent persist-cleanup latency
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `sase agent persist-cleanup` (ACE kill/dismiss persistence proc)

On athena, recent `sase agent persist-cleanup` procs ran 14–55s each (median ~31s). The original `,x` relaunch barrier (`plan:202608/kill_and_edit_prompt_latency.md`) assumed a healthy cleanup takes ~1.5–3s, so a 30s timeout would only fire for a hung supervisor. That assumption no longer holds: four `,x` cleanups in the 2026-11-27 relaunch race all exceeded 30s, and `tui.log` shows the barrier timing out several times a day since at least 2026-11-15.

The race itself is fixed by holding the relaunch until cleanup settles (with a 300s ceiling) and by one forced-reuse wipe retry. This bead is only the latency regression: profile why persist-cleanup now takes tens of seconds (startup, index sync, termination grace, or load) and restore the ~1.5–3s healthy path.

Evidence proc IDs on athena (2026-11-27): `kwycaj6tx9da`, `e2ajaa1p8pn0` (48s, the incident cleanup), `4tpkamx0c58d`, `bphq3bybz5cf`.

Do not change the relaunch barrier or wipe retry here.

task_type_fields.impact: ,x relaunches used to abandon a still-running cleanup at 30s; even with the 300s hold, tens-of-seconds cleanups remain a 10x regression from the healthy path.
task_type_fields.repro: Inspect recent persist-cleanup procs on athena; kwycaj6tx9da, e2ajaa1p8pn0 (48s), 4tpkamx0c58d, and bphq3bybz5cf ran 14-55s (median ~31s) vs the ~1.5-3s the original barrier assumed.

issue.creation_reason: The approved relaunch-cleanup-barrier plan requires a follow-up for the persist-cleanup latency regression; the barrier/wipe race is fixed separately and this bead owns only the 14-55s cleanup durations.
